check.cell_error: |b - 1| on each checked cell, b the least-squares slope of the scored logit on the derived logit over the cell's rows; a derivation that is the scale the library applies reads b = 1
check.scope: the rows compared are the check source's, on build 2014H2-E, derived by the formula and compared with rows the library scored at 1; no derived row of build 2014H2-R is compared with a scored row. The check carries to them by the identity of the library version, the checkpoint and the source temperature, which are the same across every source, the check source and the check. The derivation is approximate: what carries is the error measured on the check source's cells, under the same library, checkpoint, source temperature and device, and not a verification of the derived rows
